# SP spending priority (rough)

Per class, learn from the top: take the first entry you have the level and SP for and already know the previous level of. Tier A = rotation skills and masteries, B = useful, C = minor, skip = not worth SP. Value is a rough score (rotation use, passive stats, role); efficiency = value per 1000 SP. Classes include the skills of their earlier classes.
